blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu — Philippine representative Katrina Anne Johnson concluded her Miss International 2026 journey with a Top 20 finish after she did not secure a spot in the Top 10 during the pageant’s 64th edition on Wednesday, November 25, in Tokyo, Japan. Johnson was crowned Binibining Pilipinas International in June 2025, which gave her the right to represent the Philippines against 72 other candidates at the 64th edition of the international beauty pageant. Despite falling short of the next round, Johnson carried the Philippine flag throughout the international competition, fulfilling a decade-long dream of representing the country on the Miss International […]...
